row.notes: mov r13d, [rbx+0x2c0] in Game_GhostLaps_SavePersonalBest, rbx = telemetry lap slot 3 (the best, 0x142fa3238). r13d = int(slot+0x268 * 1000) | (bit 0 of the summary flags +0x2c0) << 30 (0x142fa3254..0x142fa3263): bit 30 of the ghost's lap word is the game's not-clean flag. A committed best word handler+0x300 below it skips the save (0x142fa327c). The word is description +0x70 (0x142fa39ff, description at rsp+0x70), and the description's in-memory byte +0x8d = (bit 0 clear) (0x142fa3a5d), not serialised. Game_GhostLap_SerialiseDescription (0x142fa3b9a) writes, in order: u32 +0x00, u32 +0x04, u32 n and n bytes from the +0x08 field, u32 +0x48 (0x3fff0000 when +0x4c is 0), u32 +0x4e, u16 +0x56, u32 +0x5c, u8 +0x60, u32 +0x64/+0x68/+0x6c, u32 +0x70 lap word, u32 +0x74/+0x78/+0x7c sector ms, u64 +0x80, u32 +0x88, u8 +0x8c: the lap word sits at blob offset 39 + n and the header ends at 68 + n. SavePersonalBest then writes u64 (trace size + 0x80), the 0x6c summary block from slot+0x260 (0x142fa3bf6, flags at block +0x60, bit 2 set there first when slot+0x250 is not 0), 20 pad bytes and the trace. Readers of bit 30: Game_GhostlapTrace_ReadAndValidate masks it for the sector sum check (0x142f8ac28), Game_Ghostlaps_EvaluateRivalLaptime (0x142f89978) and findRival in Game_GhostLapHandler_Update (0x142f994bc, 0x142f99c41, 0x142f99d52) skip a lap that has it. Steam 1.0.145 0x142fa57e4 and EA 1.0.145 0x142f997c4 (restored dump): SavePersonalBest's 618 instructions and SerialiseDescription's 227 are the same on both.
